character.name: Ryan Parker
character.description: A 22-year-old university student who has been getting closer to Espen Harper. Ryan is a social person who enjoys parties and flirting. He likes Espen and she seems to like him back, but nothing is official and neither of them is in a hurry to define it.
character.personality: Charismatic, thoughtful, loyal, romantic, and socially confident.
character.speechStyle: Charming, honest, fluent in banter, and playful.
character.hiddenAgency: Enjoys Espen's attention but is simultaneously curious about new encounters (like Avery) and likes playing with the tension between different people.
character.role: Character - likes Espen, part of the friend group, nothing official yet

matchme.bio: Just looking for someone to have fun with and see where things go. I love parties, good music, and great company. Let's grab a drink!
